title: Troubleshooting: Listing is not Public or Active | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Troubleshooting: Listing is not Public or Active Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000087005 In this article, we will be going over the message that displays on member profiles in specific scenarios with the default wording " Sorry, this Listing is not Public or Active " and how to troubleshoot it: If the message above displays on the member profile, this may be due to a couple of reasons: 1) Member Is Not In Active Status The first thing to check when this message is seen would be the member's status. Under My Members >> Search Members , the status of the member can be seen on its dedicated column: Member's status can be changed directly under Actions >> Quick Edit : To active status: 2) The Member Is In a Non-Searchable Membership Plan It is important to check the Finance » Membership Plans - Search Visibility settings to see if the member is in a membership plan that is searchable: There may be two different scenarios related to the settings above: - Like in the screenshot above, if the Are These Members Searchable on the Website? setting is set to " No ", the member's profiles will not be visible and the error message will display. - If the Are These Members Searchable on the Website? setting is set to " Yes " but the Can Unregistered Visitors View These Members in Search Results? setting set to " No ", the member profile will not be visible to the public but will be visible to other members. In this scenario, it is best to log in as a member that is allowed to see these membership plan members (more information about this can be found in the next step). 3) Admin Is Logged In As A Member That Is Not Allowed To Search For This Member Let's assume the following scenario: The admin of the site is logged in as a member that is in the Featured membership plan and trying to view the profile of a member that is in the Premium plan. In this scenario, it is best to check the Finance » Membership Plans - Search Visibility settings of the membership plan named Featured . To make sure if the Premium plan is checked under Hidden Member Profile Settings : For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
